source_snapshot.procedure: Press physical UID button from Off, then from On.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY with mapped identity, evidence and restoration.

old_problem: Button/node/indicator mapping, On appearance, press/debounce/settle timing and optional digital readback were absent, but the source's two inverse physical transitions and final Off intent are unambiguous.
disposition_reason: ED-09 assigns physical button and visual LED handling to a qualified operator. ED-03 allows chassis mapping and timing as runtime prerequisites. Because exact transition outcomes are already stated, a traceable manual test can be completed without an engineering decision or remote-command substitution.
decision_basis: Direct XLSX rows 2265 and 2266, same-row AI fields, GPT V2, historical records and unique identity were reviewed.
Preserve physical button contact coverage and both Off→On and On→Off visible transitions.
Bind chassis/node/front-rear button and indicator map, On color/mode, Off appearance and press/debounce/settle times.
Use exactly one measured press per transition with SUT-linked video; remote identify control cannot substitute for the button input path.
Supplemental BMC state/event may correlate but disagreement with the physical LED is a finding; final state must be Off.
No physical press, LED change, BMC command, retry or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: Manual UID button two-state physical toggle and final Off
test_case.purpose: Verify the mapped physical UID button input toggles the corresponding real indicator Off→On and On→Off exactly once per measured press, without affecting another node and ending Off.
required_package: Expected On color/mode and Off appearance
Press duration, debounce and settle windows
Optional BMC readback/event map and safe observation setup
test_case.test_command: Establish physical and optional digital Off baseline; a qualified operator performs one measured press, waits the configured settle window and records visible On plus readback/event; then performs one measured press from On, waits and records visible/digital Off; verify no wrong-node effect and final Off.
test_case.expected_result: The exact mapped indicator changes from confirmed Off to approved On appearance after one press, then from confirmed On to Off after the second press, with no bounce/multiple transition, wrong-node response or final-state mismatch.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires bound map/timing and real physical evidence for both transitions plus final Off. Missing runtime bindings blocks execution, not review. Remote state alone cannot pass; wrong node, bounce, missing visual transition or visual/digital disagreement is FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE as specified.
safety_gate: Qualified observer and verified physical target.
One measured press per state; wait through debounce/settle.
No remote-control substitution or repeated probing.
Stop on stuck button, multiple/wrong-node transition or evidence disagreement.
expected_evidence: First press duration and On visual/event
Second press duration and Off visual/event
test_case.recovery: If state is ambiguous or wrong, do not press repeatedly; preserve video/readback, use only the approved independent UID-Off restoration if safe, verify final physical Off and escalate.
